selection: 144 observable cells (6 controllers, 14 readouts, 128 raster display neurons), then the top 40 synaptic partners of each of the 5 controller groups by contacts, then the cells with the most contacts to the observable set, up to 500
edges_note: 6000 strongest of 9724 directed edges among these neurons, controller edges first, self edges dropped. contacts are synapse counts; sign is +1 excitatory or uncertain, -1 inhibitory
